mainEntity.name: Do you work on both XKR supercharged engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work on the XKR 4.2 supercharged engine and the 5.0 supercharged V8, starting every job with a thorough assessment.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Jaguar XKR engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour involved. We quote after assessing your XKR rather than offering a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a Jaguar XKR reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better option, we can supply and fit a reconditioned supercharged V8 matched to your XKR's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you have a Jaguar XKR engine for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source reconditioned XKR engines depending on availability. Contact us with your registration and we will check suitable options.

mainEntity.name: Does a rattle at idle mean supercharger failure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. A rattle can come from several components. An inspection is needed to confirm whether the supercharger or another part is responsible.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XKR engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe after assessing the engine.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my XKR if I live far away?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer UK-wide collection and delivery from our Essex workshop, so distance does not stop you accessing specialist help.
